title: Walking animation gone wrong
author: LeeMojave
selftext: Is it normal to have to iterate on a player model? I'm trying to make a ps1 style character model and I'm getting horrible results and burning my chatgpt pro subscription usage. I have it took me five chats back and forth to get it to make blocky hands it kept adding fingers I'm using Astra low and medium and use reference pictures I get it to write prompts for itself if it's not getting good results.

replies.author: LeeMojave
replies.body: Yeah I turned it to very high and it didn't destroy my usage like I was scared of and it came up with much better results

comments.author: GratefulForGarcia
comments.body: Are you not feeding your model to Blender MCP for rigging/animation?

replies.author: LeeMojave
replies.body: Yeah that's what I do everything done in blender. I bumped it up to extra high and got much better results.

replies.author: GratefulForGarcia
replies.body:
Yeah I rarely go below Extra High with anything involving Blender or improving animations. And never below High

And if the animations still suck after a few rounds, I'll sometimes tell it to fix the mesh instead. It seems sometimes it'll just try to get animations to work on a shitty mesh/rig unless you tell it to change both
